Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_IMU_Source_v1
Objects.description: One IMU source as the device sees it: its own sensor, or an external one heard over the bus. A device carries one instance per source, so each can be shown and calibrated on its own whichever one the device uses. Values not received read 0 with their valid flag clear.

variables.name: status
variables.description: Which values are current, and whether the device uses this source

variables.name: packets
variables.description: Updates received from this source since power on

variables.name: acc
variables.description: Accelerations X Y Z, body frame

variables.name: gyr
variables.description: Angular rates X Y Z, body frame

variables.name: mag
variables.description: Magnetic field X Y Z, body frame, with this source's calibration applied; about 1 long when calibrated
